system.description:
“How Is he able to react to everything we throw at him!?” the squad captain yelled at his team as they were failing to deal with a single shinobi. The shinobi stands in the center of the forest opening. Avoiding all attacks that are sent his way. He gracefully dodges each attack with a sly grin across his face. “Kill him! He can’t dodge us all if we attack at the same time.” The captain yells out. The lone shinobi opens his eyes revealing them to be darker than the darkest black. He smiles gracefully as they all leap towards him. He quickly weaves hand seals before releasing a wave of black chakra that overtakes the assaulting shinobi. Many fall to the ground unable to move or ever breathe. The captain looks towards his fallen forces then to the shinobi. “Looks like you guys ran out of time.” The lone shinobi gloats before attacking the captain.

—Riku Tiken

The Long Road, Ch. 19 excerpt.

The Wolf’s Curse

Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Kingsare4ever

The Kuru Clan also known as the Shadow Clan, or the Dark Clan were seen as an influential family of Monks, prophets and fortune tellers from the Land of Wolves. After migrating south through the rest of the Shinobi world, their offspring began to pick up the ways of Ninshou and ninjutsu and has since settled in the Land of Claws.

The Kuru Clan have access to a unique Dojutsu known as the Miraigan, the Eyes of Prophecy. This Dojutsu carries the trait of limited foresight on a creature or object that they can see. They also learned how to harness the properties of Yin Chakra to a great effect allowing them to mold their chakra into almost any shape and even grant it different properties usually reserved for Nature release techniques without having to learn the appropriate Nature Release.

Kuru Traits

| #### Miraigan / Will Amp / Your Miraigan grants you the following benefits / Prophetic Vision. You cannot be surprised and hostile creatures cannot gain advantage on attacks against you for being unseen or Hidden. / Déjà vu. Once per turn, when a hostile creature casts a Jutsu while within 60 feet of you, you can spend 1 Foresight, to make a Read the Enemy or Identify Jutsu check at No reaction or action cost. / Eyes of the Wolf. Your foresight extends into social and environmental situations. You gain a rank of Mastery to Insight checks and checks to Identify Jutsu and Read the Enemy. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th level and 3 ranks at 15th level. |

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis, +1 Str

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Insight, Martial Arts

Dark Vision: You have Darkvision up to 60 Feet.

Black Wolf Techniques: The Kuru Clan have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Kuru Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Yin Release Affinity: Reduce the downtime cost to learn and create Genjutsu by an amount equal to its rank (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5)

Kuru Features

Miraigan

1st Level Clan Feature

[Dojutsu]

The Land of Claws single revered Dojutsu. The Miraigan is the Eyes that see through Fate. The Kuru do not see the world the way others do. They see the outcomes of actions before they are made, the results of mistakes before attempted. These eyes see tomorrow and when you see it, is when it changes. When you enter initiative, you can active your Miraigan, which lasts until the end of combat. Alternatively, you can activate your Miraigan as a Bonus action, and it remains active for 10 minutes, after which, you require at least 10 minutes of non-use before you can activate it again.

While active you can call upon a series of future visions, called Foresight. You can do this a number of times equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You use your Foresight for features that call for it, such as Prophesize. You regain spent Foresight when you complete a short or long rest.

Prophesize. You can glimpse into the future of an ally or yourself, before dragging yourself back into the preset to give them the knowledge they need to change it. Once per turn, while in combat, on your turn, by spending 1 Foresight, select one willing allied creature you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature gains a Fortune which lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until spent. A creature can only hold 1 Fortune at a time and they can spend it to do one of the following. If you grant Fortune to yourself it does not expire until spent, or combat ends;

Foretold Circumstance. Add 1d4 to an attack roll, Skill or Ability check, or saving throw they make.

Foretold Event. They gain an additional Reaction, which can only be used for feature or jutsu that trigger when they take damage.

Black Fang

| Yin-Seal / [Mental], [Sensory] / You have been marked with a special sealing mark created by the Kuru. Kuru refers to the clan of the creature that inflicted this seal. / Once per turn, If a Kuru deals damage to a Yin-Sealed creature, the Kuru regains 1 Foresight. / Attacks a Yin-Sealed creature makes against a Kuru suffer a -2 penalty to their result. / Saving throws a Yin-Sealed creature forces a Kuru to make are treated as if they have a -1 penalty, only for the Kuru. / A creature immune to the Sealed condition is immune to this condition. / A creature can spend its action to make a DC 20 Ninshou check to remove this condition. |

1st Level Clan Feature

The Miraigan is but one trick the Kuru are capable of using. They are also able to utilize the Black Fang stance, a stance that blends their unique fighting style with their affinity for Yin Release. You learn the Black Fang Taijutsu stance, which uses your Clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage]. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits;

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6 and can deal either Bludgeoning, Necrotic or Psychic as you weave martial arts with illusions and sealing into each strike.

In place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Past Strike or Future Strike. You can only use Past Strike or Future Strike once per turn each.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Past Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, visions of past combats overlap with this one, causing them to be Confused.

Future Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, at the beginning of their next turn, they are confronted with visions of future attacks from you that bind their chakra, inflicting 1 rank of Sealed.

Yin Release Adept

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Kuru has spent generations training and mastering both their Miraigan’s ability to see the future and their unique ability to manifest their variant of Yin Release. This special variant of Yin Release allows them to emulate the properties of other Nature Releases without ever having to carry their affinities. If you cast a Jutsu with a Nature Release keyword, you can choose to have it lose that Nature Release keyword, and gain the Yin Release keyword as part of that Jutsu’s Casting. Otherwise, Jutsu you cast, can gain the Yin Release keyword as part of that jutsu’s casting. Effects that force a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC.

Yin Release. This jutsu’s damage type becomes Necrotic or Psychic. Additionally, if the jutsu could trigger any of the listed secondary effects found at the end of this section, that effect is replaced with the following; If the triggering jutsu forces a saving throw and the affected creature fails this saving throw, they are marked with a Yin-Seal until the end of your next turn. If the triggering jutsu doesn’t force a saving throw, then one of the affected creatures must make a Charisma saving throw vs the Jutsu’s save DC, being marked with a Yin-Seal until the end of your next turn on a failure.

No Nature Release: Inflicts a Condition

Earth Release: Creates difficult terrain or inflicts a Condition.

Wind Release: Swirl effect.

Fire Release: Flat damage modifier added as part of the damage calculation.

Water Release: Benefit for being near a source of Water.

Lightning Release: Overcharge effect.

Additionally, you have access to a deep pool of secret Kuru clan techniques known as Yin Arts, of which you know 1. You gain an additional selection at 7th and 15th levels.

Dual Sight

You learn to split your focus between today and tomorrow simultaneously. While your Miraigan is active, you can grant Fortune to two creature, rather than one when you use Prophesize. Though this causes you stress. You can now only use the Prophesize effect, once every other turn.

Prophetic Counter

You can now cycle between the future and the present between each step, strike and handsigns, but only while focusing on a single creature. While your Miraigan is active, you gain the Prophetic Counter ability.

Prophetic Counter. Once per turn, when a creature makes an attack targeting you and would score a hit, you can spend your Reaction and 2 Foresight to force them to remake their attack. If this would cause them to miss their attack, you can, as part of the same reaction take the Attack action targeting them.

Prophetic Weakness

You can now focus in on an enemies weaknesses and foresee their most critical openings. While your Miraigan is active, you gain the Prophetic Weakness ability

Prophetic Weakness. As a Bonus action you can spend 2 Foresight and select one creature you can see and foretell their weakness. Until the beginning of your next turn, they take +2 bonus damage from all sources. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.

Prophetic Teamwork

You can use your Miraigan to foresee the best possible way to work with your team, by viewing multiple scenarios and stitching together a plan. When an allied creature within 30 Feet of you would deal damage to a hostile creature, you can spend your Reaction and 2 Foresight to target another allied creature within 30 feet, that can target the same hostile creature. They gain the Prophetic Teamwork special action until the beginning of their next turn.

Prophetic Teamwork. This special action can only be used when it is not your turn. You can use any feature, jutsu or Attack that takes an Action, targeting a hostile creature that has taken damage this turn from an allied creature.

Yin Release – Veil of mystery

You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to share your visions with your foe, but only the ones you want to share. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, you can spend 1 Foresight, targeting them to conjure a Misfortune which can only be used against them once before the end of your next turn. You can only maintain 1 Misfortune at a time. You can spend Misfortune to achieve one of the following;

Foretold Despair. subtract 1d4 from an attack roll, Skill check or saving throw they make.

Foretold Failure. To nullify any one jutsu based bonus, benefit or effect that applies to them.

Yin Release – Chains of Causality

You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to bind a vision of the future to your foe, making it their truth, their reality. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, each time they make a Weapon attack or cast a jutsu, they suffer a -1 penalty to their AC for attacks you make against them, as each of these activities have been foreseen and it brings you closer to the destined strike you know to be true.

Beginning at 11th level, if your attack result would be 10 or higher than the AC of a Yin Sealed target, you treat that attack as a Critical hit.

Yin Release – Uncertain Future

You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to obfuscate the assumptions and plans they just had, blinding them to their own desires. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, and they cast a jutsu or spends their Action, Bonus Action or Reaction while within 60 feet of a Kuru that can see them, that Kuru can spend their Reaction and spend 2 Foresight, forcing the Yin-Sealed creature to make a Charisma saving throw vs the Kuru’s highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, the Yin-Sealed creature must perform an alternative Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or Jutsu with the same casting time, or they lose the Action they spent as the ability to perform that action is temporarily sealed.

Black Fang – Yin Palm Strike

You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike with claws like a wolves jaw. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Yin Palm Strike.

Yin Palm Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you inject Yin chakra into them, breaking their spiritual center, but marking them with a Yin-Seal.

Black Fang – Future Denial

You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike at the temple of your foe. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Denial Palm Strike.

Denial Palm Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a saving throw, using their associated jutsu modifier of the target discipline. On a failure, you inject Yin chakra into them, fragmenting their memories. Select one casting discipline between Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu and Bukijutsu; and one rank between E-Rank, D-Rank, C-Rank, B-Rank and A-Rank, for the next minute they cannot cast jutsu of the select discipline and rank. A creature affected by this remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

Black Fang – Theft of Time

You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike at where your foe believes they should be in time, replacing them with yourself and vice versa. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of an attack of opportunity, you can instead make a Time Theft Strike.

Time Theft Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you use your Yin chakra affinity to rip their belief that they belong, and delay it. You switch places with them in initiative at the end of their current turn or next turn, whichever occurs first. If this initiative movement would cause you to miss taking a turn, you instead immediately take your turn, and initiative continues selecting the creature that would have gone normally. If this initiative movement would cause you to take an additional turn this round, you skip that turn in initiative. Hostile creatures that would miss their turn due to this feature, act at the end of the initiative round. A hostile creature that would gain an additional turn as a result of this swap loses that turn instead.

Visions of what will be

| #### Black Okami / Battle Amp / You have inherited the will of Kuroi, acting as a vessel for his drive of retribution. / Okami’s Resilience. Your Miraigan processes many possible visions of the future. Each one you are victorious. You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws you do not have proficiency in. / Master of Prophecy. If you use the Foretold Event ability by spending a Fortune, you can use your Reaction for any Kuru clan ability or Jutsu, with the requirement of a Reaction. / Yin-Soaked Soul. Attacks made while in Black Fang stance carry concentrated Yin Release Chakra. Your Past Strike, Future Strike and all special Strikes learned as Yin-Arts no longer require a successful hit to force their saving throw. Now, even on a miss the target makes their saving throws, but at advantage. / Fang of Kuroi. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a Yin-Sealed creature, you can Dispel their Yin-Seal, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they face a fabricated moment of a false future they desire, becoming Stunned on a failure, until the end of their next turn. A creature stunned in this way, cannot be stunned again by this effect, until you complete a rest. / Omen of Shiroi. When a Yin-Sealed creature fails their saving throw, against a Genjutsu you cast with the Yin Release keyword, you can dispel their Yin-Seal. When you do, you can spend your Reaction, to cast one Taijutsu with the Finisher keyword, targeting them, gaining their Finisher effect, as if you cast a Taijutsu with the Combo Keyword. |

7th Level Clan Feature

The Miraigan was born out of the search for truth, but was used to facilitate a war. A war whose scars still affect the Kuru to this day. The Kuru have learned to not ask the future what to do, but to instead ask what not to do.

While your Miraigan is active outside of combat, you can spend Foresight to briefly glimpse into the future to avoid mistakes and pitfalls your future self has already fallen for. For every 1 Foresight you spend, the GM can provide 1 hint relevant to your current situation, in the form of a short 1-to-2-word warning. These hints are never to tell you what to do, but to warn you against doing something, since your Miraigan shows you visions of failures, to help guide you to a successful future.

Okami of Midnight

11th Level Clan Feature

The clan of Monks, warriors and revolutionaries all exist at the same time within the past of the Kuru, but what is lost is the blessings of Kuroi, the first Alpha. You hope to embody their blessings, their pride and their forgotten memory, by inheriting his will, learning the Black Okami Form.

As a Bonus action, while you have both the Miraigan active and are in the Black Fang stance, you can spend 4 Foresight, to enter the Black Okami Form. Entering this form causes your Yin Chakra to tattoo itself across your skin, in tribalistic patterns as your eyes gain black markings around them, making your gaze more intense, like that of a wolf. You can remain in this form for up to 1 minute, you become incapacitated or you are no longer in your Black Fang stance or your Miraigan isn’t active. Once you use this form, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.

Eye of Prophecy

15th Level Clan Feature

Each time you blink, your Miraigan peers into the sea of possible futures. You are never certain what will happen, but you make certain to prevent the worst from every occurring.

When you roll initiative, and activate your Miraigan as part of it, it peers into 5 possible timelines. Roll the following dice and record each result separately: 1d20, 1d12, 1d8, 1d6, 1d4.

These results are called your Prophetic Pool for the duration of combat. You can use these results to replace die rolls made by creatures you can see, ally or hostile, when they roll a die or dice of the same size.

If a creature rolls multiple dice of the same size as part of the same effect, you can replace one of their die results with a recorded result from your Prophetic Pool as normal, but by spending 1 Foresight for every additional die you wish to replace with your Prophetic Pools result. Each replacement uses the same value.

Once you used your Prophetic Pool to replace a result, the used die size is exhausted until you next roll initiative.
